sentences.text: Bifidobacterium breve is a species commonly isolated from the intestines of healthy breastfed infants and from human milk.
Bifidobacterium breve strain UCC2003 was shown to utilize plant, diet and host-derived carbohydrates including cellodextrin, starch, galactan and the mucin-derived monosaccharide sialic acid.
A randomised controlled trial in very preterm infants tested the probiotic Bifidobacterium breve BBG-001 for reducing necrotising enterocolitis, late-onset sepsis and death.
